program.name: Ultimate Fitness - Starter Nutrition Program

phases.progressionSummary: Protein portions 5oz -> 6oz; complex carbs introduced (yams, carrots, chick peas, squash, rice, berries); three snacks swapped for dairy/fruit options; bouillons and toasted almonds dropped. Changes printed in caps/red on the paper sheet.

modelNotes: Slot labels (Breakfast, Morning snack...) are OUR assumption - the paper grid has no row labels. Confirm with the gym.
Item 'change' field ('added'/'increased'/'swapped-in') and meal 'changesFromPreviousPhase' power the 'what's new this week' feature.
MemberLog (actual intake) will reference programId/phaseId/day/slot for adherence tracking - not modeled here yet.
